reason: Keep same-source cumulative intraday revisions append-only and point-in-time instead of making sparse native history permanently uncollectable.

changes.receiptCompatibility: Optional body.revisions binds prior record ref and prior normalized bar hash; old records remain readable.
changes.acceptance: Only explicitly declared Alpaca native same-feed cumulative revisions with later observation, unchanged open, expanded-or-equal range and increasing volume. Unsupported changes remain conflicts.
changes.consumer: Original ledger read selects one cutoff-visible version; previous decisions and raw records stay immutable.

verification: Historical cutoff and downstream latest bar
rollback: Revert consumer handling only after stopping affected intake; preserve every original and revision row and their hashes. Do not overwrite or delete source history.
